name: cg_companies_holdings
description:
Public companies' treasury holdings of bitcoin or ether, from CoinGecko (companies/public_treasury/{coin_id}).
Returns {total_holdings, total_value_usd, market_cap_dominance, companies: [{name, symbol, country, total_holdings, total_entry_value_usd, total_current_value_usd, percentage_of_total_supply}]}.
Inputs (* required): coin_id (bitcoin | ethereum; default bitcoin).
For the coin's market data use cg_coin_info or cg_coin_price.
Example: {"coin_id": "ethereum"}

coin_id.description: Coin whose public-company treasury holdings to list
